### Welcome
I am a **Full Professor** at the [Department of Telematic Engineering](https://www.it.uc3m.es/) of [**Universidad Carlos III de Madrid**](https://www.uc3m.es/). My [research](research.qmd) focuses on wireless networking, performance evaluation, and the intersection of AI and communications. Since January 2025, I've been acting as [Deputy Director of Infrastructure, Digitization, and Sustainability at the Polytechnic School](https://www.uc3m.es/ss/Satellite/UC3MInstitucional/es/ComposicionOrganismo/1371303276858/Infraestructuras,_Sostenibilidad_y_Digitalizacion).

## Latest News
* **[2026-07-28]** Fist paper of [PAISES-6G](https://paises-6g.eu) accepted! To be presented as Workshop/Special Session paper for presentation in the [2026 IEEE Conference on Standards for Communications and Networking (CSCN)](https://cscn2026.ieee-cscn.org). 
* **[2026-07-01]** [PAISES-6G](https://paises-6g.eu) project started on June 1st, [kick-off meeting in Madrid](https://paises-6g.eu/paises-6g-launches-pioneering-ai-enhanced-security-for-the-6g-era/) during June 10-11. 
* **[2025-12-15]** Jesús Pérez-Valero, Premio Extraordinario de Doctorado UC3M, [link al PDF](./pdfs/2025-12-15-premio-extraordinario.pdf)
